met_analysis:
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along long 55°E to the north of Lat 30°N.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhood between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central Rajasthan & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southeast Bangladesh & neighbourhood now lies over northeast Bangladesh & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The trough from north Coastal Andhra Pradesh to northeast Uttar Pradesh across Odisha and Chhattisgarh at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Comorin area, off south Kerala coast & neighbourhood now lies over south Kerala coast & adjoining areas at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Konkan & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
